Padma Shri awardee Cheruvayal Raman, preserver of traditional rice, dies

Cheruvayal Raman, a Padma Shri awardee known for preserving 45 traditional rice varieties, has died. He was 74 or 75 years old. Raman was recognized as a guardian of Wayanad's traditional paddy seeds.
